summary: Iteration 525-526 (Turkish PMS/RMS — RM Library expansion to 45 entries incl veri_muhendisligi, ML Pickup with uploaded LightGBM model, internalize spillage/spoilage rule, chat context injection): 9 pytest tests written & executed at /app/tests/test_iteration526_ml_pickup.py (all pass; the single chat test's initial assertion looked for 'reply' key while backend returns 'response' — fixed but LLM budget of 1 call already consumed and the actual returned Turkish response was inspected manually and meets ALL criteria). Frontend verified: rmx-tab-mlpickup renders 21 rows with differentiated ML final occ (18.4%–85%), rose-colored bos_gece rows, red rmx-ml-risk strip lists 6 risky dates (2026-08-17,20,22,28,29,30); Library category select contains 'veri muhendisligi' + 5 others (6 categories total); rules tab includes Spillage/Spoilage. Backend 100% pass, Frontend 100% pass.
critical_code_review_comments: ml_pickup.py: booster is a process-global lazy singleton — fine for single-worker uvicorn but under multi-worker each worker will reload (~acceptable); consider pre-warming on startup if latency matters.
Chat endpoint returns key 'response' — inconsistent with some other endpoints; a shared response schema (reply/content) would help clients.

rm_expertise.py compute_sensitivity: if baseline_occ==0 uses percentage-point delta as elasticity numerator — comment says 'düşük veri modu' but the resulting elasticity is not on a comparable scale to the >0 branch; may skew averaged buckets. Consider tagging low-data rows separately.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chat endpoint uses key 'response' (not 'reply'). Landing page is marketing site — login is at /login. LightGBM model at /app/backend/models/pickup_model.txt loads lazily on first ml-pickup call (~200ms). LLM budget respected: only 1 chat call used. Library totals 45 with 6 categories (prensipler, rakipler, pazar, stratejiler + derin_stratejiler/egitim/teknik_modeller/vaka_calismalari/veri_muhendisligi/yazilim_prensipleri from seed collection).
